result: Along a GD trajectory at the edge of stability the sharpness cycles through four phases (sharpen, overshoot, fall, recover). The output-layer norm ‖A‖², which grows exactly when residual and output disagree (d‖A‖²/dt = −(4/n)DᵀF), tracks the sharpness; proved for two-layer linear networks under spectral assumptions.
result_plain: Four-phase EoS cycle; the output-layer norm tracks sharpness; proofs for two-layer linear nets.
